:::{#def-vector-sequence-limit}
#### Convergence of a sequence of vectors

A [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence) $\vx^{(0)}, \vx^{(1)}, \ldots$ in $\reals^p$
**converges** to $\vx^* \in \reals^p$
if the sequence of distances $\norm{\vx^{(t)} - \vx^*}$
[converges](algebra.qmd#def-convergent-sequence) to $0$.
For $p = 1$, $\norm{x^{(t)} - x^*} = \abs{x^{(t)} - x^*}$,
and this is the convergence of a sequence of numbers to $x^*$.

:::
